note: Cloudflare Workers plan switch. "paid" = Workers Paid features on (PC live stream in the kill monitor, Oracle live fights). "free" = everything back to what fits the free plan. Both Workers read this file within ~5 minutes; no deploy needed. Emergency override: Worker variable PLAN=free (or paid) in the Cloudflare dashboard, on both Workers. Automatic: .github/workflows/plan-watch.yml (hourly) writes free here when the Workers Paid subscription is gone or free-tier limits show up (auto: true), and paid again only after its own switch when the subscription is back.
